name: RevCent Payments for WooCommerce
author: revcent_com

sections.description:
RevCent is the ecommerce operating layer behind your WooCommerce storefront. WooCommerce keeps running the shopping experience your customers know, while RevCent centralizes the business context behind every checkout: payments, customers, orders, products, visitor metadata, recovery activity, reporting, automation, and AI-ready history.

The RevCent Payments plugin links your WooCommerce store to RevCent. Once connected, checkout and order activity can flow into RevCent so your store becomes part of a connected operating system instead of a standalone storefront.

What RevCent Does for Your Store

RevCent gives WooCommerce merchants a connected backend for the work that happens before, during, and after checkout.

  • Payments and routing: manage gateways, payment profiles, saved cards, retries, refunds, disputes, and payment outcomes from RevCent.
  • Revenue recovery: use payment intelligence, retry logic, AI Assistants, and AI Voice workflows to follow up on failed or abandoned checkout activity.
  • Anti-fraud protection: help protect checkout activity from card testing, suspicious behavior, gateway noise, and chargeback risk.
  • Customer and order management: centralize customers, orders, products, subscriptions, fulfillment context, notes, events, and support history.
  • Tracking and attribution: connect first-party visitor data, URL parameters, campaigns, landing pages, conversions, refunds, and long-term customer value.
  • Reporting and intelligence: view connected sales, customer, payment, product, campaign, and recovery data through RevCent reporting and dashboards.
  • AI and automation: give AI tools the ecommerce context they need to answer questions, monitor changes, support customers, recover checkout issues, and trigger next steps.
  • Built-in business tools: use customer groups, email templates, events, functions, portals, integrations, and automation tools inside RevCent.

How This Plugin Fits

This plugin is the WooCommerce connection for RevCent. It adds the RevCent payment gateway, passes checkout and order context to RevCent, supports classic checkout and WooCommerce Blocks checkout, declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), and includes optional first-party DNS tracking for attribution.

Built for WooCommerce Stores

Use this plugin if you already use RevCent, or if you want WooCommerce to remain your storefront while RevCent becomes the operating layer behind payments, recovery, tracking, reporting, AI, automation, and customer operations. After installing the plugin, enter your RevCent API key, third party shop ID, and campaign ID in WooCommerce payment settings.

Use Cases

🤖 AI Voice Agent Use Cases for WooCommerce

Inbound Customer Service Scenarios

  • “Where’s my order?” – AI looks up WooCommerce order, provides shipping status and tracking
  • “I need to return this” – AI processes return, generates return label, updates WooCommerce order
  • “My payment failed” – AI collects new payment info and retries the WooCommerce order
  • “Can I change my shipping address?” – AI updates WooCommerce order if not yet shipped
  • “What’s your return policy?” – AI explains store policies clearly and professionally
  • “I want to cancel my order” – AI cancels WooCommerce order and processes refund if needed

Outbound Revenue Recovery Scenarios

  • Abandoned Cart: “Hi John, you left a MacBook Pro in your cart. Can I help you complete your order?”
  • Failed Payment: “Hi Sarah, your order for the dining set couldn’t process. Let’s try a different card.”
  • Shipping Issues: “Hi Mike, your order is delayed due to weather. We’re upgrading you to express shipping free.”
  • Subscription Renewal: “Hi Lisa, your monthly subscription renews tomorrow but your card expires this month.”
  • Win-back Campaign: “Hi Tom, we miss you! Here’s 20% off your next order as a welcome back gift.”
  • Cart Abandonment Follow-up: Calls customers 2 hours after abandonment with personalized offers

Advanced AI Automation

  • Intelligent Monitoring: AI watches for low approval rates and alerts via Slack/SMS
  • Automated Reporting: AI generates and emails daily transaction reports to your team
  • Sentiment Analysis: AI reads customer notes and sends apology emails for bad experiences
  • Complaint Management: AI automatically adds unhappy customers to special groups for follow-up

🎯 Marketing & Advertising
– Track Facebook and Google ad conversions with pixel-level accuracy
– Create lookalike audiences from high-value customer segments
– Optimize ad spend based on lifetime value data
– Automate conversion reporting to advertising platforms
– Use AI to analyze campaign performance and suggest optimizations
– Generate marketing insights through natural language queries

💰 Revenue Optimization
– Recover abandoned carts with automated email sequences
– Retry declined payments with intelligent routing
– Segment customers for targeted offers and promotions
– Identify and re-engage dormant high-value customers
– AI-powered payment retry with optimal timing and gateway selection
– Automated upsell and cross-sell campaigns based on purchase patterns

🛍️ Customer Experience
– Provide AI-powered customer support via chat and voice
– Send automated order confirmations and shipping notifications
– Create personalized email campaigns based on purchase behavior
– Handle returns and refunds with automated workflows
– AI voice agents for 24/7 customer support
– Proactive outreach for order issues and delivery updates

📊 Business Intelligence
– Monitor real-time sales and conversion metrics
– Generate custom reports with AI assistance through natural language
– Track customer lifetime value and churn rates
– Analyze product performance and inventory needs
– Ask AI complex questions like “Which affiliates drove the most profitable customers last quarter?”
– Create interactive dashboards and visualizations with simple AI commands

Support

Get Help:
1. Plugin Support – Contact through WordPress.org support forums
2. RevCent Platform – Dedicated support included with all accounts
3. Documentation – Comprehensive guides at RevCent Knowledge Base

Technical Support:
– WordPress admin error logs for troubleshooting
– RevCent dashboard for payment and API issues
– Test with default WordPress theme to isolate conflicts
– Check WooCommerce system status for compatibility

About RevCent

RevCent centralizes the systems that WooCommerce merchants usually manage across disconnected plugins and tools. It brings payments, recovery, anti-fraud, customers, orders, subscriptions, tracking, reporting, automation, integrations, and AI-ready business context into one operating layer.

Platform Highlights:
– AI Integration – Connect ecommerce context to AI chat, reporting, assistants, and voice workflows
– Payment Operations – Advanced routing, payment profiles, recovery, saved cards, and fraud protection
– Business Management – Centralize customers, sales, subscriptions, shipping, products, users, and notes
– Tracking and Reporting – Tie visitor data, metadata, campaigns, payments, refunds, and lifetime value together
– Developer Friendly – Use APIs, integrations, functions, and events to connect RevCent to the rest of your stack

Transform your WooCommerce store into an enterprise-level operation with RevCent’s comprehensive ecommerce management platform.

Ready to elevate your business? Learn more about RevCent for WooCommerce
sections.installation:
Quick Setup:

  1. Install the Plugin

    • Install from the WordPress plugins directory
    • Activate the plugin

  2. Create Your RevCent Account

    • Visit RevCent to set up a demo

  3. Configure the Gateway

    • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > RevCent Payments
    • Enter your API credentials from your RevCent account
    • Enable the payment gateway

  4. Advanced Setup (Optional)

    • Enable DNS tracking for cross-domain visitor tracking
    • Configure payment routing and anti-fraud settings in RevCent
    • Set up automated email templates and customer segmentation

🎙️ AI Voice Agent Setup for WooCommerce:

  1. Phone Number Integration

    • Connect your existing business phone number or get a new one through Twilio
    • Configure inbound routing to RevCent AI Voice Agents
    • Set up outbound calling from your business number

  2. WooCommerce Data Access

    • AI automatically syncs with your WooCommerce customer and order data
    • Configure customer matching by phone number and email
    • Set up real-time order status and inventory access

  3. Voice Agent Instructions

    • Customize AI personality to match your brand voice
    • Configure store-specific policies (returns, shipping, etc.)
    • Set up escalation rules for complex issues

  4. Automation Triggers

    • Inbound: Route calls based on customer type or issue
    • Outbound: Auto-trigger calls for failed payments, cart abandonment
    • Proactive: Schedule follow-up calls for VIP customers

  5. Quality Assurance

    • Review call transcripts and recordings
    • Monitor AI performance and customer satisfaction
    • Continuously optimize based on real customer interactions
sections.faq:
What makes RevCent different from other payment processors?

RevCent is a complete ecommerce management platform, not just a payment processor. You get AI automation, advanced analytics, revenue recovery, anti-fraud protection, and business management tools all in one platform.

Can I manage multiple WooCommerce stores?

Absolutely. RevCent is designed for multi-store operations. You can centralize management, reporting, and customer data across all your WooCommerce stores in one dashboard.

What about subscription products?

RevCent excels at subscription management with advanced renewal recovery, automated billing, and customer lifecycle management.

How does the AI automation work?

RevCent’s AI is revolutionary in ecommerce. It can:
– Chat everywhere: Ask questions and give commands throughout the platform
– Handle phone calls: AI voice agents answer customer calls and make outbound calls
– Run autonomously: AI assistants work 24/7 in the background following your custom workflows
– Generate insights: Ask complex questions in plain English and get interactive reports
– Take actions: Process payments, send emails, manage orders, and more automatically
– Learn and adapt: Uses latest AI models from OpenAI, Google, xAI, and others

The AI has access to 100+ system tools and can be customized with your own JavaScript functions.

What about fraud protection?

RevCent includes Sentinel, an advanced anti-fraud system that prevents fraudulent transactions from reaching your merchant accounts, protecting your payment processing relationships.

Can I track conversions across multiple domains?

Yes! RevCent’s DNS tracking sets first-party cookies across all your domains, providing accurate conversion tracking.

What AI models does RevCent support?

RevCent integrates with all major AI providers including OpenAI, Google AI (Gemini), xAI (Grok), and OpenRouter. You can easily switch between providers and models to use the latest AI technology as it becomes available.

How do AI Voice Agents work with my WooCommerce store?

RevCent’s AI Voice Agents are game-changing for WooCommerce customer service:

Inbound Call Handling:
– Customer calls your store number → AI answers professionally
– AI automatically looks up caller in your WooCommerce customer database
– Can access full order history, shipping info, and payment details
– Handles 80%+ of common questions without human intervention
– Seamlessly transfers complex issues to human staff when needed

Outbound Call Automation:
– Triggers automatically when WooCommerce orders fail or are abandoned
– AI calls customers with personalized information about their specific order
– Can collect new payment information and retry failed transactions
– Follows up on shipping issues, delivery confirmations, and satisfaction

WooCommerce Integration:
– Direct API connection to your WooCommerce store data
– Can process refunds, update orders, and modify customer information
– Accesses product catalog to answer detailed product questions
– Updates order notes and customer records automatically
– Works with your existing WooCommerce workflows and processes

Real Conversations:
– Uses advanced voice synthesis that sounds completely natural
– Handles interruptions, clarifications, and complex conversations
– Adapts tone and language to match your brand voice
– Provides complete call transcripts for quality assurance
– Available 24/7 in multiple languages and time zones

Can AI Voice Agents increase my WooCommerce sales?

Yes! AI Voice Agents are proven revenue drivers:
– Cart Recovery: Recover 15-25% of abandoned carts through personalized calls
– Payment Recovery: Retry failed payments with 40-60% success rates
– Customer Retention: Proactive service calls increase lifetime value by 20-30%
– 24/7 Availability: Never miss a customer inquiry, even outside business hours
– Instant Response: No hold times or delays mean happier customers
– Consistent Service: Every customer gets the same high-quality experience
